name: How long does popcorn ceiling removal take?

mainEntity.name: How long does popcorn ceiling removal take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of popcorn ceiling removal depends on the size and complexity of the project. For a standard room, the process including preparation, removal, and initial cleanup might take 1-3 days. If extensive repairs to the drywall are needed or if a new texture and paint job are included, the project could extend to 3-5 days or more. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popcorn ceiling removal typically takes 1-3 days for a standard room, extending to 3-5 days or more with repairs and finishing.
